description: A grid keeps its columns in a collection, written as Columns = <item ... end>, and each item carries both the heading and the width that has to hold it. The heading is translated already; the width was never planned, because a collection item is not a control and the layout scan has never seen one. A German heading is a single unbreakable word - there is no space to wrap at and a grid heading does not wrap in any case - so width is the only thing that can give. Seventy-two pixels will not hold Spielverabredungen at any readable size. Seventy-two is the width it is drawn at, so a hundred is proof it was actually given room rather than merely found.
